name: Aether
tagline: An autonomous command centre for student life: morning briefs, deadline triage and cross-course insights.
problem: Students juggle scattered academic systems and deadlines.
solution: Pulls from the academic ecosystem with browser automation, triages tasks with Gemini and the campus AI platform, and shows a knowledge graph and daily brief with voice.
demo_moment: Team-described: open the morning brief and see triaged deadlines.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Bitcamp Hack - Bitcamp” and “TerpAI Ultimate Agent Showdown - Cloudforce/Microsoft” among 223 submissions.
Won a top Bitcamp prize and the campus AI agent showdown.

lessons: An agent that triages for you beats another dashboard.
